## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6b4df96580b3df1875177a9d899eb5a8b0baf947`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs + scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs

Read for this record: card #37064 (body and its three comments: triage `7140844924`, claim `7212727941`, dev report `7213921132`; no ruling and no earlier record on the card), PR #37882's body, its file list (three files, +369 / -118) and its net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on this head. The cited code was read on `origin/main` at `b620c4b2`; `main` has not touched the three files since the merge base `02ed8408`.

Check-runs on this head: 49 in all, 26 completed with `success`, 23 `skipped`, none in progress, none red. The ones this record leans on: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`. The `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` lane ran the FAST tier (its log: `2358 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred`); see ③.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff changes no published package, schema or accept set. What it changes is what the tool derives, and the module's own exports.

- **A FieldSchema or protection-fields key change still derives the same three commands** (driver-sql, metadata-core, metadata-protocol), now under three rows instead of one. Right: `field` is in all three pins, and all three read through spreads.
- **An ObjectSchema key change now derives metadata-core's test and the metadata-protocol test.** Right. `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts:810-812,847` holds `OBJECT_REFERENCE_POSITIONS` equal to ObjectSchema's keys less `fields`, both ways; `CARD_PROPERTY_COUNTS` counts `object`.
- **A key change in any of the other twelve counted types derives the metadata-protocol test.** Right. `getMetadataTypeSchema` binds each of the thirteen names to the schema its row declares (`metadata-type-schemas.ts:94-208`), and the test adds the stripped tombstones back, so the count is the declared key count.
- **`action` joins the served pin.** Right. The same file pins it at 55 (`:280`); a row for thirteen types would have named that test and still missed an action key.
- **A ReportSchema own-key change derives the ui inspector test; a change to the two spread objects does not.** Right. The coverage case is `toStrictEqual` against `getReportSchema().properties` and builds its exclusions from `Object.keys(MetadataProtectionFields)` and `Object.keys(OverrideDeclarationFields)`, so a key added there cannot red it.
- **A key added to `OverrideDeclarationFields` derives the metadata-protocol test alone.** Right. Field and object do not spread it; action, app, dashboard, dataset, flow, page and report do.
- **A rename derives the metadata-protocol test though no count moves.** Right as declared: an over-derivation, stated in the row's `why`; the card's subject is the key set.
- **An unchanged file (the PM's surface before the code exists) derives nothing.** Right: the asymmetry #37046 landed with, unchanged.
- **`FIELD_SCHEMA_KEY_DECLARATIONS` and `changesFieldSchemaKeySet` are gone from the module's exports.** Right: no file on `main` outside these three names either.
- **A new load-time refusal** (`servedKeySetPredicates`, a pin naming a type with no row). Right: a pure function of two frozen tables, empty on the committed data, pinned empty by the self-test.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` is right. The three files sit under `scripts/pm`, in no workspace package; nothing is published. `Check Changeset`: success.
- `Clause-②: no`, on the PR body and the card: right. No published schema, protocol surface or accept set moves.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: right. The diff names a metadata-protocol test in a row; it changes nothing in the package.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` is empty. The dev's deviations and out-of-scope findings, each answered:

- **No ablation.** Answered. The CONTROL cases ran in CI's fast tier and passed; the dev file's carve-out for scripts is not this record's to re-rule.
- **Fast tier only, locally.** Answered, with a correction: the PR-event lane also runs the fast tier only, so the nine slow sections ran on this head nowhere. I read their nine labels and searched the battery: none names a key-set row, a pin or a declaring file. They run on push to `main`.
- **`check:i18n-coverage` not measured locally; `test:repo` not run.** Answered by the check-runs: every Lint lane and `Test Core` are green on this head.
- **`action` added in place.** Answered in ①: right.
- **Spec files edited in a throwaway worktree; the shared clone deepened.** Nothing of either is in the tree at this head: the diff is the three claimed files. The shallow boundary of the shared clone is the seat's to judge.
- **Footer and trailer deviation.** Not this record's subject; the seat's ACCEPT.
- **Out-of-scope finding, the nested key-set pins.** Escalated to the seat: it owes the card. The family is wider than the report lists. Two more nested whole-set pins, found by reading: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-unauthorable-columns.test.ts` (the page component row at 13 keys, `:265`; the dashboard widget row held equal to a named list) and `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/dashboard-widget-options-census.test.ts` (the widget options keys, both ways). The card's population should come from a search, not from the report's list.
- **`carrier: none`, the app-shell accept-set tests.** Answered: read at `MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts:174-192`. A near-spelling check over three retired names, not a whole-set pin; no row is right.

Raised by this review:

- **The data module's header says a new gate family under a kind lands "still only on the maintainer's words".** The card carries no maintainer ruling, and the diff adds three rows. The PR is Tier H, so his hand merge is that word. This record does not stand in for it. Escalated to the maintainer, at the merge.
- **SQL push-down.** No query, id materialisation or in-app join in the diff.
- **Security and rule-change lines.** No `hits` path is under `skills/**`, `ui/skills/**` or `.claude/**`; the path-filled template carries neither line, and none is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

**`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (hits).** `changesServedKeySet` holds against the sixteen declarations it cites and the card's scenario, with one exception (S1).

- Each of the fourteen type rows reads the literal that carries the served schema's keys. I read all fourteen on `main`: each is the second argument of the first `strictObject(` after the named binding, and none chains a key-moving call after it (only `superRefine`, `refine`, `describe`). By hand: tool 7 + 7 = 14, position 7 + 7 = 14, report 16 + 7 + 1 = 24, the numbers the pin spells. CI's census agrees for all fourteen (`14 types; drift: none`).
- Tried and held: a key added, removed or renamed; a reorder; a named spread added; a key added to either spread object, read through to exactly the pins whose types spread it, at base or head; a declaration renamed or moved out of the file (reads wide); a file created or deleted (reads wide); prose, `describe()`, refine, nested-schema and strictness-option edits (derive nothing). The `throughSpreads: false` arm never opens the spread files for the report pin.
- A route a key can take that is not a member of the literal (a call chained on it, a shape built by a helper) is left to the count census, which reds on `main`. That is the declared net, and none of the fourteen uses such a route today.
- The tier and clause code is untouched: the hunks are the import and export lists, this predicate and the predicate table. The fast tier's tier cases pass.

**`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` (implements).** Agrees with the contract.

- "No logic" holds: two frozen tables and three rows of strings; the predicates are bound in the engine, as the population nets are.
- The four pins are what the rows say. I read each test on `main`: driver-sql's table (field, both ways), metadata-core's two tables (field and object, both ways), the metadata-protocol counts (thirteen plus `action`), the ui coverage case (report, own keys).
- A fifth top-level pin: searched for, not found. I searched every test outside `packages/spec` for `Object.keys` of a shape, the shape-key helpers, `toJSONSchema` and the ui schema helpers, per-type numeric pins and property-length pins, and read each hit that names one of the fourteen. Each is a declared-key guard, a near-spelling check or a nested set. Not exhaustive by construction: a spelling-level search.
- The row texts hold where I checked them: the Test UI binding and its seven-package build match the existing `ui-scripts-suite-input` row and `ci.yml`; `ui/vitest.config.mts` aliases only the sdui-parser.
- The history figures (69 commits, 68 replayed, 12 fired) were not re-measured here. They add up, and the twelve match the count comments in the pinned test.

**`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` (enforces).** The pins are not vacuous. The roster is held from both sides, `KS_HOLDS` is written out and not read from the table under test, each type is driven through all four pins with a control, and the censuses hold the reader to numbers the pinned tests spell. All pass in CI on this head.

No must-fix.

S1 (should-fix) — a spread whose operand is not a bare name reads as no member, so a key added that way derives nothing.

- Where: `objectLiteralMembers` pushes a spread only when a name path follows the dots (`/^\.\.\.\s*([A-Za-z_$][\w$.]*)/`). For `...(X as unknown as Y).shape`, `...(cond ? A : {})` or an inline `...{ k: v }`, no branch matches and nothing is pushed.
- Effect: such a line added to one of the sixteen literals leaves the member list equal, and `changesServedKeySet` answers false. The count moves, Test Core reds, and the dev learns it a CI round late: the card's defect, for one spelling of "a key added through a spread".
- It is a live idiom in this package, not a hypothetical one: `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts:1353` spreads a cast shape into a schema shape, and `app.zod.ts:206-245` carries thirteen parenthesised spreads beside `AppSchema`. None sits inside the sixteen literals today.
- It contradicts three sentences this diff writes: the data docblock's "A spread reads as one member" and "a member object nobody watches cannot join a shape quietly", and the self-test's "every spread a type declares has a row of its own". The `unwatched` census filters on members that start with the dots, so it would print `none` over such a spread.
- The count census does catch the state, on `main`'s push run after the landing, not on the PR that adds the line.
- What closes it: the member reader pushes a non-name spread as its source text, as it already does a computed key, so its arrival is a set change and the `unwatched` census names it; with one member-reader case and one edit-shape case ("a parenthesised spread added to the shape derives").

Nits, each left as an accepted deviation or for the follow-up card on this file (none is on a prose face):

- N1 (nit) — two censuses read another lane's test as raw text. `const EXCLUDED = new Set([...])` is captured to the first `]` and `CARD_PROPERTY_COUNTS` to the first `}`, unmasked, so a comment inside either literal that carries a bracket, a brace or a quote reds the census on a legitimate edit. `lint.yml`'s read-set skips this self-test on such a PR, so the red first appears on `main`. Masking comments before the two regexes removes it.
- N2 (nit) — the `unwatched` census reads the type rows only. A spread added inside `MetadataProtectionFields` or `OverrideDeclarationFields` is held to no row; the count census catches it unless the nested object carries exactly one key.
- N3 (nit) — "cannot join a shape quietly" is true from `main`'s push run, not on the PR that adds the spread, for the read-set reason in N1.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `44c822a1bfd713d34509b5fbe118effd9c5ec7fd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs + scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs

Delta record on record `7214302668` (head `6b4df965`), for its finding S1. Judged here: the one commit `6b4df965..44c822a1` (three files, +33 / -9), and what it made me re-read: the member reader whole, its three callers, the two censuses whose inputs it masks, and the sixteen live declarations' closing lines. Also read: the dev's fix report `7222790533` on card #37064, and card #37884 with its comments.

Check-runs on this head: 44 in all, 25 completed with `success`, 19 `skipped`, none in progress, none red. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` ran the fast tier again (its log: `2360 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred`), with both new cases and every LIVE census green.

### ① Derived judgments

- **A spread whose operand is not a bare name is now one member, read as its source text.** Right. Its arrival, removal or rewording changes the set, so the row derives.
- **A spread is read as a bare name only when the name is the whole operand.** Right. `...make()` is now the member `...make()`, where it was `...make`. No live member changes: the sixteen declarations still read (`16`), the four censuses print the same numbers as on the last head (14 types, 89, 51, 14 + 2), and `unwatched` is `none`.
- **The two pinned test files are read with comments masked.** Right. A self-test change only; nothing the tool derives moves.
- No published package, schema or accept set is touched. The reader's only callers are `declaredKeySet` and, through it, `changesServedKeySet` and `spreadByAPinnedType`.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` is still right: the round stays in the same three `scripts/pm` files. `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on this head (it was `success` on the last one).
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still stand on the PR body, and are still right.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` is empty. The fix report's deviations:

- **No ablation.** Answered as before: both new cases are positives that ran in CI, and the reader as it stood on `6b4df965` is the counterexample.
- **`check:i18n-coverage` not measured locally.** Answered by the check-runs: every Lint lane is green on this head.
- **`origin/main` not merged.** Answered: no commit on `main` since the merge base `02ed8408` touches the three files, and the PR reads `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Both tiers run locally (2675 cases, 315 slow).** The dev's measurement, taken as data. No check-run ran the slow tier on this head; the round touches nothing a slow section names.
- **The report's line count** (+31 / -8) is a miscount. The round is +33 / -9, read from the tree.

Carried from the last record:

- **N2 and N3** ride card #37884 (scope note `7214316940`), with the two nested pins this review found. Nothing of them is in this round, as directed.
- **"Only on the maintainer's words".** Still stands: the Tier H hand merge is that word, and this record does not stand in for it.
- **The PR body's Tests section** still spells `6b4df9658` and 2358 cases. It is prose, and the seat's to refresh; this record judges the tree.
- SQL push-down: no query, id materialisation or in-app join in the round. No `hits` path is under `skills/**`, `ui/skills/**` or `.claude/**`.

### ④ Design judgment

S1: closed.

- **The reader.** In `objectLiteralMembers`, the name-path regex now ends on a lookahead for the comma or brace that ends the member. Any other member that opens with the dots sets `spreadAt`, and `closeSpread` pushes its source text, whitespace collapsed, at the member's comma or at the literal's closing brace. I walked the three shapes the last record named and the call form through the loop by hand: a cast (`...(X as unknown as Y).shape`), a conditional, an inline literal and `...make()` each come out as one member, with the neighbours on both sides intact.
- **The contract.** A parenthesised spread added to one of the sixteen literals now differs from the base, so `changesServedKeySet` answers true. The `unwatched` census filters on members that open with the dots, so it names such a spread where it printed `none` over it before.
- **The two cases asked for are there and green in CI**: the member-reader case (five spread forms in one literal) and the edit shape `a parenthesised spread added to the shape`.
- **The three sentences now hold.** The data docblock says a spread is one member "or its source text when the operand is not a bare name", and the reader's own docblock says the same.

N1, fixed in this round though the last record left it as a nit: both pin files pass through `maskComments` (the scanner in `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, strings kept, offsets kept) before the three regexes and the `MAXIMAL` read. A bracket, brace or quote in a comment inside either literal is no longer structure. Right.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` agree with the engine after the round. The tier and clause code is untouched: the engine hunks are the reader and its docblock.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

One new nit, for card #37884 with N2 and N3 (it is not on a prose face):

- N4 (nit) — the name-path lookahead reads a 200-character window, and a non-name member's text is cut from the unmasked source. Two narrow effects, new in this round:
  - A bare-name spread that is the LAST member, with no trailing comma and more than about 170 characters of comment before the closing brace, now reads as a text member that carries the comment. The edit that drops the comma derives the row (wide, not quiet), and the `unwatched` and count censuses then red on `main`. Until that is repaired, a change to the spread object is not read through to that type. No literal is in that state: `HookSchema` has such a comment after `...MetadataProtectionFields,` and keeps its comma, as does every spread in the sixteen literals today (`unwatched: none` in CI).
  - A comment inside a non-name spread's own span is part of that member, so rewording it derives the row. An over-derivation, in the safe direction.
  - Reading the lookahead over the masked text without the window, and cutting the member from comment-masked text, removes both.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感。这是车队的门禁推导工具 `dispatch-gates`:开发者改了某个元数据类型的顶层字段集合时,工具会直接告诉他要跑哪几个整集测试;以前只认 `field` 一种类型,现在 14 种类型都认得。
- 为什么做:#37064(p2)——12 种类型加字段时本地门禁全绿、CI 却红,开发者要白等一轮 CI 才发现;回放 68 个历史提交,新规则只在 12 个真正改了字段数的提交上触发,不会误报。
- 出错会怎样:只会让工具多列或少列一个该跑的测试,CI 仍是兜底;撤回 = 回退本 PR。
- 要你做什么:`dispatch-gates.mjs` 是守卫仪器,Tier H,需要你审批。契约审核 PASS 评论 7222932507,`Head-sha: 44c822a1bfd713d34509b5fbe118effd9c5ec7fd`。另:数据模块头注写着新门禁族"只凭维护者原话"落地,本卡上没有你的裁决——你批准合并即算这句原话(两轮审核记录都点了这一条)。

席位意见:建议批准。两轮契约审核(7214302668 → 7222932507)唯一的应修项 S1 已关;终轮无必修、无应修。

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · 2026-11-27T16:11Z · L1 · Head-sha: `44c822a1bfd713d34509b5fbe118effd9c5ec7fd` · reports: os-dev-report 7213921132, 7222790533 on #37064

LIVE censuses green: 14 types, drift none; field 89; object 51; report 14+2; `unwatched: none`.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [46038607099](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46038607099) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Build Core](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46038607099/job/140640541763)** — 失败步骤: Build packages (excluding docs)（日志不可读，点进 job 看）
- **[Live E2E UI](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/46038607099/job/140640541934)** — 失败步骤: Build the Console for the live lane

  ```
  ✗ Build failed in 5.72s
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
